summary: Build evidence-based product strategy, vision, and roadmaps with practical workshops, templates, and leadership-ready outputs.
lede: Product strategy, vision and roadmapping connects market and customer evidence with business goals and delivery capacity to set product direction. For product managers, product owners, product leaders and portfolio professionals, it develops skills in assessing product baselines, prioritizing opportunities, defining measurable goals, and sequencing initiatives with dependencies and timing into a roadmap decision-makers can review.
audienceIntro: This product strategy, vision and roadmapping course is designed for professionals who shape product direction, manage prioritization, and turn evidence into an executable plan.
outcomes: KPI Tree and North Star Metric Design
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of product development, business goals, and cross-functional delivery. You should be comfortable reading basic product metrics, talking through customer needs, and reviewing roadmap priorities with stakeholders. No coding is required. This course is appropriate for intermediate learners who already support or own product planning and want a more structured, evidence-based approach to product strategy, vision and roadmapping.
